items.title: 13.5 Kinetic theory aur statistical physics (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of kinetic theory and statistical physics (PDF 11-12).

blocks.text: Kinetic theory ideal gas ka dabao us ke molecules ki be-tarteeb hararati harkat se nikalti hai. Bohat bari tadaad ke molecules ke liye hum statistical physics use karte hain, physics ki woh shakh jo ihtimal (probability) ki theory use karti hai. Is tasawwur mein nizam ke atoms aur molecules mukhtalif raftaron ki wajah se mukhtalif energy states (levels) E1, E2, E3 waghera mein ho sakte hain.

blocks.title: Boltzmann distribution law
blocks.text: Do energy levels E1 (neecha) aur E2 (ooncha) ke liye un ki aabadiyan N1 aur N2 ka talluq N2/N1 = e^(-dE/kB T) (13.19) hai, jahan dE = E2 - E1. Factor e^(-dE/kB T) Boltzmann factor kehlata hai. Kisi khaas energy state mein molecule paane ka ihtimal energy ko kB T se taqseem karne par exponential tor par ghatta hai, is liye oonche ke muqable neeche energy states mein zyada zarrat hote hain.

blocks.alt: Do khaane, har aik mein paanch barabar faasle wale energy levels E1 se E5. Kam darja hararat par 25 zarrat: E1 par 16, E2 par 6, E3 par 2, E4 par 1, E5 par 0. Zyada darja hararat par wahi 25 zarrat: E1 par 10, E2 par 6, E3 par 4, E4 par 3, E5 par 2.
blocks.caption: Energy levels mein zarrat ki Boltzmann taqseem (asal khaaka; kitab mein yeh figure nahi).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Dono khaanon mein zarrat (particles) barabar, 25 hain: garam karne se zarrat barhte nahi, sirf oopar ke levels mein phail jate hain. Kam darja hararat par zyada tar zarrat sab se neeche E1 par hain aur E5 khali hai. Zyada darja hararat par kB T bara hai, is liye Boltzmann factor e^(-dE/kB T) bara hota hai aur oopar ke levels ki aabadi barhti hai, lekin har oopar wala level phir bhi neeche wale se kam bhara hai.

Gas ke bartan mein aik molecule har second arbon takkarein karta hai. Har takkar us ki raftar aur yun kinetic energy badalti hai, lekin kinetic theory batati hai ke darja hararat T par ausat kinetic energy Eav = (3/2) kB T (13.20) hai, jahan kB darasal fi molecule gas constant hai. Ideal gas ka model woh bunyaad hai jis se statistical mechanics paida hui; tabdeeliyon ke saath yeh 'ghair-ideal' gases ko bhi samjhata hai, jaise sitaron ke andar garam, ghani gas (topic 13.6).

blocks.title: Aap ki maloomat ke liye
blocks.text: 1860 mein James Clerk Maxwell (1831-1879) ne hararati tawazun par nizam mein molecules ki raftaron ki taqseem ka formula nikala. Taqreeban 60 saal baad tajurbaat ne Maxwell ki peshgoiyon ki tasdeeq ki.

blocks.prompt: Do levels ka faasla dE = kB T hai. Neeche level ki aabadi ka kitna hissa oopar level mein hai?
blocks.explanation: N2/N1 = e^-1, taqreeban 0.37: oopar level mein neeche ke muqable taqreeban 37% zarrat hain.

items: Statistical physics bohat se zarrat ke liye ihtimal use karti.
Boltzmann qanoon: N2/N1 = e^(-dE/kB T); neeche levels mein zyada zarrat.
Eav = (3/2) kB T; ideal gas model statistical mechanics ki bunyaad.
